rows.label: auroraRibbon is merged into BG (same object as BG_R6), reachable through overlay.js ALL_KINDS, with tags, doc and order, and the other backgrounds are still there
layers/manifest.json lists background.auroraRibbon with file layers/backgrounds-r6.js, tags, params, doc and this test (node make-manifests.mjs rewrites it)
cuesR6: the pivot cue resolves in sfx/manifest.json (sfx/hit/sub_drop), has a time >= 0 and a reason
defaults draw at 2 s (8388 canvas calls, finite numbers, additive blend set and restored)
auroraRibbon: 23 param variants all change the draw and stay finite
kick / kickDur are read right after riseAt and have no effect once the flash has decayed (the same frame 3 s later with and without kick)
auroraRibbon 16:9: identical draw calls in forward and shuffled order (70 seeks over [-0.5, 8.6] s, finite)
auroraRibbon 9:16: identical draw calls in forward and shuffled order (70 seeks over [-0.5, 8.6] s, finite)
auroraRibbon 1:1: identical draw calls in forward and shuffled order (70 seeks over [-0.5, 8.6] s, finite)
pure function of t across processes: six frames (three sizes, loop, seed, transparent bg) hash to the same value here and in two fresh node processes (e2e27f99206b)
no state between draws: A, B, A, B in turn give the same A and the same B

before riseAt (t = riseAt - 1 frame, and t < 0): no gradient, no additive blend, the same calls whatever the colours, height and halo are; at riseAt (k = 0) it is still the bare field; 0.3 s later the ribbon is there
bare field with grain 0 = one background fill and nothing else (a transparent field = nothing)
auroraRise: 0 up to riseAt, 1 from riseAt + rise, monotonic non-decreasing in between, never outside [0, 1]

property test (300 random parameter sets): at k = 0 the whole glow of every strand (3.2 sigma, strand offset included) is below the frame bottom (worst margin 13.0 px, 0 = touching); at k = 1 the centre line stays within crest * H of the rest height
closed form: with crest 0 the centre line is exactly H - height * H at every x and t; at k = 0 it is below the frame bottom, halfway through the rise it is between
drift is slow: the centre line moves at most 0.91 px per frame at 1080p (mean 0.37) with the defaults (limit 1.2)
colour weights stay in [0.22, 1], move with t, and differ between strands (the colour mix travels along the ribbon)
pivot flash: 0 before riseAt, kick at riseAt, decaying monotonically to 0 by riseAt + kickDur, 0 after; a loop has none
the flash is drawn: the brightest gradient stop at riseAt + 0.05 s is higher with kick 0.5 than with kick 0 (0.173 vs 0.140)
loop 2: frame t and t + 2 s are identical (7 times, centre lines within 1e-6 px, grain included); a third of a loop later it is a different frame; the ribbon is already up at t = 0
loop 4: frame t and t + 4 s are identical (7 times, centre lines within 1e-6 px, grain included); a third of a loop later it is a different frame; the ribbon is already up at t = 0

loop 7.3: frame t and t + 7.3 s are identical (7 times, centre lines within 1e-6 px, grain included); a third of a loop later it is a different frame; the ribbon is already up at t = 0
loop 10: frame t and t + 10 s are identical (7 times, centre lines within 1e-6 px, grain included); a third of a loop later it is a different frame; the ribbon is already up at t = 0
without loop: frame t and t + 6 s differ (the drift keeps going)
grain index: counts up at grainFps (24 per s at 30 fps: 4 new specks sets per 5 frames), wraps with the loop, and never goes negative

grain: 0 draws no specks, more grain draws more specks (0 / 592 / 1481), the count is capped (12000 specks at 8K, cap 12000), the same index gives the same specks, the next frame different ones, another seed different ones
grainFps 10 at 30 fps: the specks change every third frame (frames 0-2 share them, frame 3 has new ones)
unique per item: the draw emits no ids (no url(#...), clipPath, filter), and two layers of the same kind on one page (different colours and seed, rendered in turn) draw exactly what each would alone

guards: 19 numeric parameters x 8 hostile values (0, negative, +-1e9, 1e15, +-Infinity, 0.5) never throw, never hang (< 4 s each), stay finite, and draw at most 83556 canvas calls (cap 130000: res <= 1024 columns, <= 5 strands, <= 12000 specks)
guards: NaN, a string, null, undefined or an object for any of the 19 numeric parameters throws an error that names auroraRibbon and the parameter
guards: a colour that is not #RGB / #RRGGBB, fewer than 2 colours, or colors that is not an array throws a clear error; #RGB shorthand is accepted; more than 5 colours use the first 5
guards: t that is NaN or infinite throws; a zero, negative or NaN frame size throws; t = 1e9 and t = -1e9 draw finite numbers
auroraParams clamps: res 1e9 -> 1024, waves 99 -> 5, grain 5 -> 1, height 9 -> 0.9; the defaults come back unchanged; colours become RGB triples
cuesR6: the sound lands `lead` s BEFORE riseAt (10.8 - 0.1, 10.8 - 0.4), is never before 0, and is absent for a loop
cuesR6 of an unknown kind throws
